import numpy as np

def _dense_expansion(value, n_modes):
    value = np.asarray(value, dtype=float)
    if value.ndim != 2 or value.shape[1] != 2:
        raise ValueError("The result must have two columns.")
    masks = value[:, 0].astype(np.int64)
    if np.any(value[:, 0] != masks) or np.any(masks < 0) or np.any(masks >= 2**(2*n_modes)):
        raise ValueError("The output masks must be valid integers.")
    if len(masks) > 1 and np.any(np.diff(masks) <= 0):
        raise ValueError("The output masks must be unique and increasing.")
    result = np.zeros(2**(2*n_modes))
    result[masks] = value[:, 1]
    return result
